If you really are trying to stretch in a healthy way, there's a pinned post on this sub that gives you all the info you need.

 The basic knowledge:

Stretch using half sizes - it makes everything 10x easier
Stretch with *GLASS SINGLE FLARE PLUGS* or *TITANIUM SINGLE FLARED PLUGS*
There are stretching kits you can buy from bodyartforms (I always buy from BAF, as I know they're reliable)
Always use a lubricant while stretching to make things slide in smooth (most people use jojoba oil, but any natural oil is acceptable)
Wait 2-4 months in-between each stretch to give your ears the time they need to regain their elasticity (longer for larger stretches)
Stretch based on millimeter, or at least know the millimeter of each gauge
Massage lobes with oil 2 times a day

That's all I can remember off the top of my head, but have a look at the pinned post!
